sysSecurity.allowedDomainsTooltip:
1. Only applies to public link access under Whitelist Mode
2. One host per line, in the form host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.3:5505, img.example.com:8443). Same host on a different port counts as a different source
3. Matching is by the source's host + port: both must match. Paths and query strings are ignored
4. Example: allowing 192.168.1.3:5505 lets any page under http://192.168.1.3:5505/ (including /?id=29, /post/29.html) through, but a request from 192.168.1.3:55105 is still blocked (different port)
5. Pasting a full URL is fine (only the host + port is kept). Empty = no restriction

sysSecurity.s3ConfigTip: Path-Style addressing, Region must be us-east-1. Bucket must be a channel ID (the 6-char ID shown on the Channels page; the channel name is not matched). The response header returns this site's signed link. If your client builds URLs itself, set the custom domain to the access domain above.
sysSecurity.webUsageTip: Put the token in a custom Body field to upload. Optional username / userstore: when username is passed and userstore is not false, the account's storage/backup channels from User Management are used and the file belongs to that account; otherwise the channel is taken from this token's storage/backup channels → the global default in Upload Settings. Compression is controlled by the compress field: send true / 1 to compress (GIF is skipped), or omit it to upload as-is. The returned url is the link issued by this site.
sysSecurity.credentialKeptTip: Credentials are kept permanently — come back to this page anytime to view or copy them.
sysSecurity.s3BucketAutoTip: Bucket accepts a channel ID (6 characters), "auto", or an empty value: with auto/empty the object is stored in this token's default storage channel; an unknown or disabled channel ID also falls back to it.
sysSecurity.webJsonPathTip: Set the JSON path to "url" to return the full data packet, or to "data.url" to return only the file link value.
sysSecurity.enforceLimitsHint: When on, files sent with this token are restricted by the allowed formats and per-file size cap
sysSecurity.enforceLimitsTooltip: On (default): files sent with this token are restricted by the allowed formats and per-file size cap in "Upload settings". Off: both restrictions are skipped. Applies to both Web and S3 tokens.
sysSecurity.mailConfigTooltip:
Used to send email verification codes, 2FA login codes and 2FA-disable codes.
The password is stored encrypted; the API only reports whether one is set.
Examples: QQ Mail smtp.qq.com:465, 163 smtp.163.com:465, Gmail smtp.gmail.com:465 (all SSL).

When enabled, any file link that cannot be served loads the fallback instead:
· Image: the image bytes are returned (same URL, replaced content)
· Redirect: 302 to the given URL
Covers forbidden / missing / not-public / expired cases.

aiErrors.PROVIDER_BLOCKED: Provider security protection blocked the request (HTTP 403). Check firewall rules.
aiErrors.PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN: The provider denied the request (HTTP 403). Check model and image input permissions.
aiErrors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: The provider rate limit was reached. Try again later.
aiErrors.PROVIDER_ERROR: The provider returned HTTP {status}. Check the model and endpoint.
aiErrors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot connect to the provider. Check the network and Base URL.
aiErrors.TIMEOUT: Recognition timed out or was cancelled. Please retry.
aiErrors.UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: Cannot process this image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF.
aiErrors.PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE: Image exceeds the processing limit; skipped.
aiErrors.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid request parameters. Check your input and retry.
aiErrors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file no longer exists. Refresh the file list.
aiErrors.UNSUPPORTED_INPUT: The model or file does not support image tag recognition.
aiErrors.INVALID_IMAGE: The image preview is invalid or exceeds limits. Generate it again.
aiErrors.FILE_CHANGED: The file has changed. Generate tags again.
aiErrors.INVALID_TAGS: Tag format or count exceeds limits. Reduce or edit the tags.
aiErrors.METADATA_TOO_LARGE: File metadata exceeds the KV 1 KB limit. Reduce the tags.
aiErrors.INPUT_TOO_LARGE: The request exceeds size limits. Reduce the images or tags.
aiErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Operation failed. Please try again later.
aiErrors.AUTH_REQUIRED: The admin session has expired. Please log in again.
aiErrors.IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED: Image retrieval failed (HTTP {status}). Check file access permissions.
aiErrors.HTTP_ERROR: Request failed (HTTP {status}). Please try again later.
aiErrors.NETWORK_ERROR: Request failed. Check your network and retry.
aiErrors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This AI capability is not supported.
aiErrors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This request method is not supported.
